about_the_game:
The Ursine Nations have always had a less than stellar relationship with the neighboring Aquatic Kingdom— likely on account of the bears’ favorite delicacy: fish. Despite this, the two societies have enjoyed relative peace, both respecting the treaty that ended their feud all those years ago. However, unrest is churning in the waves and the fish of the Aquatic Kingdom have suddenly decided to invade the bear’s territory! As the leader of the Grizzlies, one of the factions within the Ursine Nations, it is up to you to fend off these intruders.

Rally your troops...

Command the battlefield as a fierce Grizzly warrior and use your resources to deploy a variety of bear units.

  • Buff Your Army: Place buildings and utilize tower buffs to defend your city. 

  • Spawn Allies: Spawn Grizzly bears, Panda bears, and Polar bears to utilize their unique abilities to destroy your enemies.

  • First Person: Fight alongside your troops in first-person mode

Build up your defenses...

Use natural resources to construct and upgrade defensive structures like catapults and crossbows.

  • Tower Building: Place and enhance towers with ranged attacks or elemental effects.

  • Environmental Strategy: Block river routes, build on high ground, or funnel enemies into choke points.

  • First-Person Engineering: Jump into the action to reinforce crumbling defenses in real time.

... and push back the tides of war!

short_description: A twist on the tower-defense genre, play as a bear tribe chief defending their home against the forces of the ocean as they attack you in anger and retaliation due to overfishing. Place towers, command minions, and defend the camp from the enemy.
